item.title: Tue 6 Oct: ASOS push-alert hack, NetScaler SAML zero-day, FortiMail 9.8
item.description: ASOS customer messaging platforms hijacked with Snowflake extortion claim; NetScaler SAML zero-day and critical FortiMail flaw exploited; Rejetto HFS scanning; Dell and Exchange fixes; Denmark population register breach; ShinyHunters arrest; RMM abuse.
